script.title: GETTING A LIBRARY CARD
script.story_hook: A brand-new card opens up the whole building.
script.intro_zh: 一張全新的借書卡，打開了整棟書香。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, glad you're here! Today we're getting a library card.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，朋友們，真高興你們都來！今天我們要一起辦借書卡。
script.outro: That's one happy card! Keep listening and see you soon.
script.outro_zh: 一張開心的借書卡就辦好啦！繼續多聽，不久後再見。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn — repeat each line after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你上場——跟著我一句一句重複。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful woman in her thirties with chestnut hair in a loose side braid, wearing a denim jacket over a small floral dress, her young son tugging on her sleeve
script.char_b_description: a gentle man in his fifties, balding with a tidy gray goatee and thin silver frames, wearing a mustard sweater vest, stamping due-date cards as he talks
script.youtube_title: 【📚辦借書卡英文】「有罰款嗎」怎麼問？18句圖書館對話🎧聽完就敢開口💡｜🌱A2初級｜Library Card English
script.youtube_title_en: "Happy Reading!" — Getting a Library Card at the Front Desk
script.youtube_description:
剛搬來卻不敢用英文辦借書卡？這集幫你大膽開口！跟著 Nora 在圖書館櫃台填資料、用電費單證明住址、比較電子卡與紙本卡，再問借期、遺失該怎麼處理，還有WiFi密碼。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就敢實戰。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Just moved in and too shy to ask for a library card in English? This episode fixes that. Follow Nora at the front desk as she fills out a form, proves her address, compares e-cards with paper cards, then asks about due dates, lost books, and the wifi code — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section. 
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new listening episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📚辦借書卡英文｜填資料單・選電子卡・問借書規則｜聽完就能辦卡｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
剛搬到新社區，想去圖書館借書卻不敢開口？
填表、住址、電子卡，這些英文到底怎麼說？

這一集帶大家走進安靜又溫暖的圖書館，跟著 Nora 從填寫資料、用電費單證明住址、挑選電子卡或紙本卡，一路問到借期、遺失該怎麼處理，還有WiFi密碼，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🪪 辦卡與資料：例如「Do I need proof of my address?」。
📖 借期與規則：例如「Three weeks, and renewals are free, no fines.」。
🛟 小意外與網路：例如「What if I lose one, though?」，還有「What's the wifi code, by the way?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先完整聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

辦好卡的那天，記得真的去借一本你最愛的書！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a shiny new library card

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how do I get a library card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈlaɪbrɛri kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下，請問借書卡要怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easy! Just fill this short form with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi dʒʌst fɪl ðɪs ʃɔrt fɔrm wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 很簡單！跟著我把這張短表填好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool. Do I need proof of my address?
dialogue.phonetic: /kul du aɪ nid pruf ɑv maɪ əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 好。我需要證明自己的住址嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a piece of mail, like a bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə pis ɑv mel laɪk ə bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 只要一封郵件，像是帳單就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've got an electric bill right here!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪv ɡɑt ən ɪˈlɛktrɪk bɪl raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我手上剛好有一封電費單！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now, email signup or paper card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt naʊ ˈimel ˈsaɪnʌp ɔr ˈpeɪpər kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那要電子卡還是紙本卡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the difference between the two, um?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə ˈdɪfərəns bɪˈtwin ðə tu ʌm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An e-card works on your phone for e-books.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ikɑrd wərks ɑn jɔr foʊn fɔr ibuks/
dialogue.zh: 電子卡可以用在手機上看電子書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, I love that — digital is great for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /u aɪ lʌv ðæt ˈdɪdʒɪtəl ɪz ɡreɪt fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 哦，我喜歡——數位版最適合我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then done! Your card number starts with nine-nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn dʌn jɔr kɑrd ˈnʌmbər stɑrts wɪð naɪn naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那就辦好了！你的卡號從九九開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Awesome. Can I bring my nephew along too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔsəm kæn aɪ brɪŋ maɪ ˈnɛfju əˈlɔŋ tu/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了！我可以帶侄子一起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, kids under twelve just need a guardian.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr kɪdz ˈʌndər twɛlv dʒʌst nid ə ˈɡɑrdiən/
dialogue.zh: 可以，十二歲以下只要有家長陪同。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, then how long can I keep books?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðɛn haʊ lɔŋ kæn aɪ kip buks/
dialogue.zh: 好，那書一次可以借多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three weeks, and renewals are free, no fines.
dialogue.phonetic: /θrik wiːks ənd rɪˈnuəlz ɑr fri noʊ faɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 三週，續借免費，也沒有罰款。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No fines? What if I lose one, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ faɪnz wʌt ɪf aɪ luːz wʌn ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有罰款？那要是不小心弄丟一本書呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just pay replacement cost, around five bucks.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst peɪ rɪˈpleɪsmənt kɔst əˈraʊnd faɪv bʌks/
dialogue.zh: 只要補一本書的錢，大約五美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough! What's the wifi code, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪr ɪˈnʌf wʌts ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ koʊd baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很合理！對了，WiFi的密碼是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's at the desk — happy reading, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ət ðə dɛsk ˈhæpi ˈridɪŋ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 密碼就在櫃台上——祝你閱讀愉快，再見！
